resolved_findings.description: Resolved by correction cda04bb, which removed 'order-flow\.test\.js$' from apps/web/jest.config.js testPathIgnorePatterns. `npx jest order-flow.test.js --listTests` now lists apps/web/order-flow.test.js; `npm run test:e2e` invokes `jest order-flow.test.js --runInBand` and the test file executed. The local Windows run encountered environment-specific operation timeouts (1/6 passed, 5 timed out), not a test discovery/configuration failure; CI's configured runner is ubuntu-latest.

findings.description: The .github/workflows/e2e.yml created at T8 done_sha 081dd2f was deleted in commit 33134ad 'Upd'. This is post-plan drift outside all task done-ranges and remains observed/minor.

T4 logger unit tests (e2e/support/logger.test.ts) remain blocked from Jest discovery by the retained <rootDir>/e2e/ ignore pattern in jest.config.js. `npx jest e2e/support/logger.test.ts --listTests --json` returned an empty test list. This remains Minor and non-blocking.
